title: PJM Files Amended Reliability Backstop Proposal

meta.summary: PJM filed an amended proposal to FERC with the goal of commencing a Reliability Backstop Procurement on March 1, 2027. Central to Thursday’s filing are modifications to three elements of the original filing: the method for determining the cost allocation for Reliability Backstop charges, LSE credit requirements and LSE exit responsibilities.
